faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the holiday apartment in the Vulkan Eifel at a glance.

questions.q: Where exactly is the MaarZeit holiday apartment located?
questions.a: The apartment is in Kirchweiler, Am Bruchborn 6, in the Daun district in the Vulkan Eifel (Rhineland-Palatinate). The Daun Maare are reachable in around 6 minutes from Kirchweiler, and the town of Daun is just 6 km away.

questions.q: How big is the apartment and how many guests can it accommodate?
questions.a: The apartment is 35 sqm and accommodates up to 3 guests. It has a double bed and a sofa bed (usable as a fold-out bed for a third person). New build 2023.

questions.q: Are dogs allowed in the apartment?
questions.a: Yes, dogs are very welcome. The Vulkan Eifel offers numerous dog-friendly hiking trails, forests and excursion destinations – including Freilinger See with a designated dog beach (approx. 45 km away).

questions.q: What does the apartment cost per night?
questions.a: Prices vary by length of stay: 1 night €125, 2–3 nights €95/night, 4–7 nights €85/night, 7+ nights €75/night. A flat cleaning fee of €20 per booking applies. Book directly with no platform fees.

questions.q: How far are the Daun Maare from the apartment?
questions.a: The Daun Maare – Gemündener Maar, Schalkenmehrener Maar and Weinfelder Maar – are just 5–8 km from the apartment and reachable in a few minutes by car. A real advantage of our location in Kirchweiler.
Yes, a dedicated parking space directly at the property is included free of charge. Ideal for motorcyclists who want to park their bike securely, and for guests with lots of luggage.

questions.q: Is the apartment suitable for motorcyclists?
questions.a: Absolutely. The Vulkan Eifel is one of Germany's finest motorcycle regions. Private parking, winding Eifel roads right outside, Nürburgring approx. 55 km and the Moselle approx. 45 km – the perfect base for day trips.

Choose your dates in the calendar, enter your details and pay a 30% deposit securely via Stripe (credit card, SEPA or Apple/Google Pay). The remaining 70% is due on arrival. Book directly with your host – no platform fees.

questions.q: What are the best excursion destinations in the Vulkan Eifel?
questions.a: Highlights near Kirchweiler: Daun Maare (6 km), Wild & Adventure Park Daun (6 km), Eifel Volcano Museum (6 km), Eagle & Wolf Park Kasselburg (20 km), Gerolsteiner Erlebniswelt (18 km), Dreimühlen Waterfall (18 km), Manderscheid Castles (18 km) and the Nürburgring (55 km).

Accessible directly from Kirchweiler: circular walk around the Daun Maare, Lieserpfad (51 km long-distance trail), Eifelsteig, Manderscheid Castle Trail and various HeimatSpuren circular routes. Suitable for all fitness levels.

questions.q: Does the apartment have a kitchen?
questions.a: Yes, the apartment has a full kitchenette with dishwasher, refrigerator and cooking facilities – ideal for self-caterers and longer stays. Plus a terrace with garden furniture and a fire bowl in the garden.

questions.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
questions.a: Check-in from 3:00 PM, check-out by 11:00 AM. For special requests, please feel free to contact us – we will do our best to be flexible.
